**Praktiserende kardiologer** (practicing cardiologists) refers to a group of private specialist cardiologists in Denmark who have recently become an integrated part of the national quality assurance framework for atrial fibrillation. Starting on June 1, 2023, data collection from these practicing cardiologists was formally established and integrated into the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) [^src1] [^src3]. This integration marks a significant paradigm shift in the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] annual reports, moving from a purely hospital-centered approach to a more comprehensive, population-based quality measurement that includes the primary and specialized private care sectors [^src1] [^src3].

In the 2024 reporting period, the inclusion of this sector was a first, with 15 practicing cardiologists contributing data that covered 5% of all incident patient pathways for atrial fibrillation [^src1]. The geographic distribution of these specialists is heavily skewed, with the vast majority located in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], which hosts 13 specialist practices [^src2]. Other regions have significantly fewer practicing cardiologists contributing to the database: [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] has 2 practices [^src2], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] has 1 [^src2]. 

By the 2025 reporting period, the data from practicing cardiologists was included for the second time, continuing to account for 5% of incident patient pathways involving the same 15 cardiologists [^src3]. The epidemiological impact of this group is notable: nationally, they treated 1,064 incident atrial fibrillation patients, representing 4.8% of all incident cases [^src4]. In [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] alone, practicing cardiologists managed 790 incident patients, which constitutes 12.7% of all incident cases seen in specialist practices within that region [^src4]. Conversely, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] reported zero incident patients treated by practicing cardiologists [^src4]. The inclusion of this group provides crucial empirical evidence for identifying regional inequalities in access to specialized cardiological assessment and supports the broader political and clinical strategy of shared responsibility across healthcare sectors in Denmark [^src1] [^src3].

## Timeline

- 2023-06-01: Tilknytning af praktiserende speciallæger i kardiologi til AFDK blev etableret, og deres data begyndte at indgå i databasen (praktiserende-kardiologer, atrieflimren-i-danmark)
- 1. juni 2023: Start af dataindsamling fra praktiserende speciallæger i kardiologi til AFDK (praktiserende-kardiologer)
